title: Task envelope handed to a player
description: The framework wraps every per-task input in this envelope. The 'input' field's inner schema is defined per arena in arenas/<arena-id>/schemas/input.schema.json.

difficulty.description: Map from difficulty-axis id to value. Keys must match difficulty_axes in arena.yaml.

visibility.description: Optional. Whether this task's input/gold may appear in tool reports as a public drilldown. Defaults to 'held_out' (fail-safe) when absent. Generators are responsible for tagging tasks based on whether the source content is committed to the public repo. Derived from `split`: revealed -> public, private -> held_out.

split.description: Optional. Which benchmark suite this task belongs to. 'revealed' = the published Open Benchmark (gold committed, full per-task results disclosed). 'private' = the contamination-protected official leaderboard suite (gold gitignored, findings redacted). Both splits are produced from the same generator + injected-mistake catalog over the same difficulty x mistake matrix, so they are parity-matched by construction. Defaults to 'revealed' when absent (a bare envelope with no split is, by definition, exposed). See arena.yaml#benchmark_splits and framework/parity.py.
